messages:
olivia_cs: Heads-up — Newton Analytics onboarding: document-summarize and long-chat flows have a growing tail. p50 140ms, p95 ~480ms, p99 ~1.6s, avg tokens ~1.3k. Account lead says renewal discussion in 10 days; they flagged latency and cost. Any low-friction canary ideas?

rafael_ml: Two pragmatic levers: 1) int8 quantization on a compact variant with conservative profile (expect small quality delta on summaries), 2) route requests above 1200 tokens to the compact canary. Also enable prefix/KV caching for doc repeats.

ben_sre: I can stand up a tiny dedicated canary pool (3%) and apply a token-length route. Need acceptance criteria (latency & quality delta) and rollback rules.

olivia_cs: Acceptance: p95 < 320ms AND summary quality regression <=1.0% (ROUGE/sim). Cost target: -20% per 1k tokens. Rollback immediate if client-reported issues or automated quality check fails.

rafael_ml: Canary plan (draft):

```yaml
canary_name: newton-compact-int8-mini
steps:
  - pct: 3
    model: redwood/compact-v2
    quant: int8_profile_E
    cache_prefix: true
    fallback: redwood/llm-standard
  - wait: 8h
  - pct: 20
metrics:
  - p95_latency
  - summary_quality_delta: "<=1.0%"
  - error_rate: "<=0.5%"
```

Also recommend dynamic batching disabled for interactive paths to preserve tail latency. Route rule: send token_count > 1200 to canary during window.

ben_sre: I'll apply routing JSON and provision the pool. Routing config I will deploy: {"route_policy":"token_length","threshold":1200,"destination":"newton-compact-int8-mini","fallback":"llm-standard"}. Gate at 3% and attach tracing.

sara_success: Ill schedule a 20-min enablement call with Newton eng to set expectations and capture edge-case prompts. Contact is sam@newton.ai, Tue 11am PT. Also request a 1-pager: expected latency gains, cost delta, rollback steps and sample before/after outputs.

monitor-bot: Canary job "newton-compact-int8-mini" created by ben_sre. Start epoch 4991240000. Alerts: p95>320ms, error_rate>0.5%, quality_delta>1.0% threshold. Monitoring dashboards: https://console.redwood.ai/mon/newton-canary

olivia_cs: Thanks. Plan: 1) enablement Tue 11am PT (sara invite), 2) rafael finalizes playbook + attach expected diffs, 3) ben provisions 3% canary (monitor-bot confirmed), 4) run 48-72h and collect failing examples, 5) scale to 20% only if p95 <320ms and quality_delta <=1.0%. Ill update thread after call. :thumbsup:
